fair_value_reason: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep-2027 ~$6.0 (0.25 x $5.20 + 0.75 x ~$6.25 FY28 on ~20-21% growth) x ~34x = ~$204. The FCF cross-check is ~$7.7B FY28 FCF at ~3.1% (~32x) plus ~$15.5/share horizon net cash (~$20B / 1.28B shares), ~$203 ex-cash + $15.5 = ~$213. A 60/40 blend is ~$208. Relative to the agents: agent_2's FCF leg is ~$5 too rich (a 2.8% yield is a higher multiple than its own P/E); agent_3's P/E leg double counts horizon cash against EPS that already includes interest income, offset by its low 32x; agent_5's FCF leg understates conversion relative to its own cash build. One dollar below my round-1 $209 because FY28 growth views of 15-17% from two agents are not unreasonable for a capex-deceleration year.

thesis_triggers.event: All five agents again choose $140, and nothing found this round moves it. It is ~31% below spot and ~27x FY27 consensus EPS ($5.20), under the ~34x five-year average forward multiple, and just below the May-2026 lows ($135-142 intramonth). A close below it would mean a fundamental break (Microsoft/Meta capex cut, a hyperscaler moving 1.6T back-end to white-box or Nvidia, a guide-down, or deferred revenue unwinding), not the kind of ~48% drawdown ANET had in 2025 on tariff and multiple compression alone. Note that the 2025 episode shows even a non-fundamental drawdown can come close.

supervisor_summary: The round-2 forecasts have converged: fair values of $200-213 (mean $205.6), all thesis breaks at $140, and a mean ladder that puts P(>= $204) at 54% with a median near $210. The shared inputs trace to one fact base (consensus EPS $5.20, ~$15/share horizon cash), not five. Fact checks show Celestica's 1.6T white-box lead is about one quarter, and memory inflation is largely inside Arista's 62-64% GM guide. Neither justifies a heavier bear case than the current ~22-25%. agent_5's valuation-conditioned base rate rests on recalled EPS and is contradicted by ANET's own 2024-25 high-multiple months, so I half-weight its low middle. That nudges the ladder up ~0.5 point around spot and sets fair value at ~$208. The next tests are both before the Oct 30 one-month mark (Celestica's Oct 26-27 investor day and the hyperscaler capex prints), with Arista's own Q3 likely on Nov 3.
key_drivers: FY27 consensus non-GAAP EPS is $5.20 (FY26 $4.11) and spot is ~41x NTM. Every agent's base case has ~25% EPS growth largely absorbed by de-rating to ~32-35x, and each 1x of exit multiple is ~$6/share.
Two customers are 42% of revenue (Microsoft 26%, Meta 16%). The late-October hyperscaler 2027 capex remarks and the Celestica Oct 26-27 investor day are the next read-throughs.

Share and the next generation: IDC has Nvidia ahead of Arista in branded DC Ethernet (2Q26 20.4% vs 18.7%). Celestica's 1.6T white-box ramp at two hyperscalers starts about one quarter before Arista's Q4-2026 7060XE7, but Meta and Microsoft endorsed the Arista platform.

Visibility vs inventory risk: $6.87B deferred revenue (acceptance-gated), $9.6-9.7B purchase commitments covering chip shipments into Q3 2027, and $13.34B cash with no debt (~$15/share projected at the horizon).

ANET's own record from 37-41x NTM starts (Dec 2024-Jan 2025, Sep-Oct 2025) is +19% to +40% 12-month returns, but with a ~48% interim drawdown. That supports a median near or slightly above spot with a fat left tail.
